what: Session rehydration plan only specifies an allowlist session-env parser
scenario_or_breakage: The bash wrapper seeds orchestrator exports (DESIGN_TMPDIR, SUMMARY_OUTCOME, ISSUE_NUMBER, etc.) before sourcing session-env.sh, then overlays file values, then derives binary-found when still unset. A file-only allowlist read drops env-only keys and breaks operator-cancel audit (OUTCOME=) and pause-save (--issue/--repo).
suggested_fix: Match bash order: bind known keys from os.environ defaults, overlay allowlisted session-env.sh exports, then derive CODEX_BINARY_FOUND/CURSOR_BINARY_FOUND when unset; document the required key set.
